text:
alex: Kicking off a tidecheck for the canary sample pin. Deploybot shows 3% traffic to v2. Need stop/go in 10m. @maria @jay @ops-qa please ack.

maria: on it. posting release notes link — https://releases.redwood.dev/rel-2026-03-23-v2 :paperclip: 

deploy-bot: AUTOMATED: Canary started: service=runtime-api, variant=v2, audience=3%, initiated_by=alex, started_at=1789123456. Monitors: latency, 5xx-rate, embed-quality.
jay: quick telemetry snapshot from span viewer: 
```
qps: 105 -> 108 (steady)
p95: 120ms -> 190ms (spike)
5xx: 0.3% -> 0.9% (sampled)
error-note: increased 502s on edge eu-west-1
```
ops-qa: saw a small uptick in transformer OOM logs on canary tasks around t+4m, but not full node failures. log excerpt: `gpu0: cudnn error: OOM while allocating KV cache`
sarah: hmm, is that from v2 only? any correlation with batch_size/sequence_length?
jay: looks like v2 has slightly bigger KV footprint for long seqs. Batch size unchanged. We only routed a handful of long sequences to canary.
maria: release notes include quantization change and new attention kernel. ops asked to pin if 5xx > 0.7% or p95 > 150ms for 5m.
alex: propose: HOLD. Requesting everyone to vote stop/go. If any objections shout now.
sarah: vote: stop. we should roll back to v1 for safety.
ops-qa: vote: stop. preferring a pin and gradual re-eval after kernel revert.
jay: +1 stop. will dig into KV allocation pattern and see if we can hotfix config.
maria: voting stop. I'll prepare a rollback note and update the changelog with the observed regressions.
deploy-bot: ACTION: Canary halted per consensus. Rolling traffic back to variant=v1. rollback_initiated_by=maria, rollback_ts=1789123602.
alex: thanks all. maria, can you include the early log snippets and a one-liner rollback rationale in the release ticket? I'll schedule a follow-up postmortem if this persists.
maria: yup. filing ticket now — https://tracker.redwood.dev/issue/INF-4521 and attaching logs.
jenkins-bot: scheduled: rollback-job #4521 started (CI link)
alex: reassigning canary re-run to jay and ops-qa to validate KV changes in staging before another canary attempt. closing tidecheck thread. :lock:
